note: This menu lists VALUES that may appear in an address. It is pooled across every dataset in the environment: the thirteen ECB snapshot files, the external register, the three SPACE respondent waves and the virtual ENV0 dataset. It does NOT say which dataset carries which dimension, and it does NOT list valid combinations. Not every entry, and not every combination of entries, exists. Composing an address that does not exist is a commitment and is scored as one. Codes are WAVE-NATIVE and deliberately not harmonised: the same INSTRUMENT or PURPOSE code means different things in different survey waves, and both resolve. Every figure is computed from the source values at full precision and reported rounded to 6 decimal places; never derive from an already-rounded figure.

dataset_descriptions.ENV0: the environment's own address space: the targets a build states, not a source
dataset_descriptions.PAY: ECB payments statistics, the aggregate payment-services tables
dataset_descriptions.PCN: ECB payments statistics, payment cards in circulation
dataset_descriptions.PCP: ECB payments statistics, card payment counts by card scheme and function
dataset_descriptions.PCT: ECB payments statistics, credit transfer counts
dataset_descriptions.PDD: ECB payments statistics, direct debit counts
dataset_descriptions.PEM: ECB payments statistics, e-money payment counts
dataset_descriptions.PIS: ECB payments statistics, payment initiation service counts
dataset_descriptions.PLB: ECB payments statistics, losses due to fraud per liability bearer
dataset_descriptions.PMC: ECB payments statistics, card payment counts by merchant category code
dataset_descriptions.PPC: ECB payments statistics, post office giro institutions
dataset_descriptions.PTN: ECB payments statistics, terminals provided by resident PSPs
dataset_descriptions.PTT: ECB payments statistics, terminal transactions (ATM, POS)
dataset_descriptions.SCALE: a unit constant, not a source: millions per unit
dataset_descriptions.SPACE: the PUBLISHED SPACE tables, as the ECB releases them: aggregates already computed and printed
dataset_descriptions.SPACE_MICRO: the SPACE RESPONDENT-LEVEL MICRO FILE: one row per respondent per purchase slot, with the survey's own weights
dataset_descriptions.SSP: ECB payments statistics, securities settlement / other PSP statistics
dataset_descriptions.SURVEY_FRAME: the survey's own frame constants, such as days per year

constants.MEDIAN_MIN_OBS_counted_on: stated amounts, not rows -- the distinction PN_W_AMT exists to make
constants.WEIGHTED_MEDIAN: the LOWER weighted median: sort the stated amounts ascending, accumulate the respondent weights in that order, and return the first amount at which the cumulative weight reaches or passes half of the total weight. No interpolation, no averaging of the two central amounts, no unweighted fallback.
constants.UNITS: EVERY count-valued and euro-valued ENV0 target is carried in MILLIONS, unconditionally. This is the ECB snapshot's own convention, and it is what makes six decimals attainable: two correct constructions of the same survey quantity can differ in the sixth decimal at raw scale and agree exactly in millions. On ENV0 addresses UNIT_MEASURE=PN and UNIT_MEASURE=EUR both mean millions, and UNIT_MEASURE=PC is a DIMENSIONLESS FRACTION and not percentage points -- forced rather than chosen, because the route A chain multiplies a count by a share and the grammar admits no literal 100 with which to convert. The ECB snapshot files already publish counts and euro amounts in millions and need no conversion; the SPACE respondent files do not.
constants.UNIT_MEASURE_RAW: UNIT_MEASURE=RAW means SOURCE UNITS, INTERMEDIATE USE ONLY. It is legal ONLY on an ENV0 address, and ONLY as the target of an UNREQUIRED derivation: no key ever sits at raw scale. Its purpose is the standard survey-composition idiom -- unrequired SUM(raw cells) -> ENV0 .../UNIT_MEASURE=RAW, then required PRODUCT(that target, SCALE) -> ENV0 .../UNIT_MEASURE=PN. The raw intermediate is checked only against your own operands, so two routes that differ by one unit in the sixth decimal at raw scale both credit the identical millions key.
constants.SCALE_MILLIONS_PER_UNIT: 1e-6, addressed as dataset SCALE with BASIS=MILLIONS_PER_UNIT and no period. A published convention with an address, for the same reason SURVEY_FRAME's 365 has one: a literal is not an operand.
constants.CHAINED_TARGET_PRECISION: a derivation's target carries the candidate's STATED value, rounded to 6 decimals, and every key is built the same way
constants.POWER_LITERAL_RULE: a literal may appear ONLY as the second operand of POWER, drawn from the whitelist above. Every other operand is a claim about a source. POWER itself is reserved for stream 2, so in a stream-1 task NO literal is legal anywhere.

RATIO.note: first over second, undefined on a zero denominator

POWER.note: first raised to the second, the second a whitelisted literal. RESERVED FOR STREAM 2 (18 Aug): it exists for the compound-growth chain and forecasting is model-building judgement. Refused at the stream-1 boundary.

env0_unit_measures.note: RAW is legal only on an ENV0 address and may never carry a key. See the UNIT_MEASURE_RAW constant above for the idiom it exists for.

env0_quantities.reserved_note: PARKED by the register ruling of 17 Aug 2026 and, for ANNUAL_FACTOR, by the stream ruling of 18 Aug. Per-head is a sanity check and the external check is triangulation, and both are stream-2 material, so no population or FEVAD table enters this register and nothing in a stream-1 task may be keyed against these codes. They stay in the enum so the ruling is legible and so a stream-2 task can use them without a menu rebuild; the boundary treats a stream-1 commitment or derivation target on one as a format error. PER_HEAD_ADOPTED is minted rather than taken from spec 9.3, which carries a single PER_HEAD: S8's route-A per head and S10's adopted per head are two values of the same shape at the same country and period, so under spec 12.6 one code cannot hold both.

mcc_classes.note: The five classes every named merchant category is classified into, named as the model's own classification sheet names them (21 Aug: the workbook's names are used verbatim, per the T3 design note). The classification itself is scored per code at T3 and is not published here.

space_micro_wave_sets.note: Per wave: every PURPOSE and INSTRUMENT code the respondent file carries, and the non-response codes of each variable. RULED 17 Aug (R2): missing codes are per VARIABLE and per wave, not per wave alone, and are excluded from every denominator; that rule is GIVEN at T3. ★AMENDED 21 Aug (rebuild pass): the goods-purpose and card-funded-instrument sets are NO LONGER PUBLISHED here. T3 scores them per code, so publishing them in the menu would hand over the key; they remain resolver constants and the candidate's commitment. Every code below is addressable and resolves, including the non-response ones.
